The lofty looks of man will be brought low, the arrogance of men will be bowed down, and Yahweh alone will be exalted…

I will make all my mountains a road, and my highways shall be exalted.
The Lord Yahweh’s Spirit is on me, because Yahweh has anointed me to preach good news to the humble. He has sent me to…
All the trees of the field will know that I, Yahweh, have brought down the high tree, have exalted the low tree, have…
But let the brother in humble circumstances glory in his high position;
I will bring the blind by a way that they don’t know. I will lead them in paths that they don’t know. I will make…
“I will go before you and make the rough places smooth. I will break the doors of bronze in pieces and cut apart the…
Therefore lift up the hands that hang down and the feeble knees,
and make straight paths for your feet, so what is lame may not be dislocated, but rather be healed.

translations.web: Every valley will be filled. Every mountain and hill will be brought low. The crooked will become straight, and the rough ways smooth.
translations.bsb: Every valley shall be filled in, and every mountain and hill made low. The crooked ways shall be made straight, and the rough ways smooth.
translations.kjv: Every valley shall be filled, and every mountain and hill shall be brought low; and the crooked shall be made straight, and the rough ways shall be made smooth;
translations.asv: Every valley shall be filled, And every mountain and hill shall be brought low; And the crooked shall become straight, And the rough ways smooth;
